title: config.snapshot payload v1
description: Derived view of the configuration change store (D-068, owner C0; TR1): every override folded as of one config.changed event, so a reader of a long log reads the newest window of it and never a truncated one. A snapshot adds no change: replaying the log without it gives the same overrides. Repository-level: pr is null.

overrides.description: {name: value} of every parameter whose latest change up to `through` sets a value.

through.description: The event_id of the newest config.changed event folded in.

count.description: How many config.changed events the log held up to `through`.

at.description: When, RFC 3339 UTC from the injected clock (the envelope's occurred_at).
